entries.rule: Decision 16: toxicity at or below the effective exposure is contra; count the harm in dose when the model predicted it but misplaced the margin
entries.note: Monkeys stated no glucose change to 20 mg/kg and hypoglycemia only at 30 mg/kg in saline (none with dextrose); patients had drug-related hypoglycemia at 1-6 mg/kg. Margin misplaced >5x, though dosing was not blocked. Abstract-level; dextrose use in patients not verified.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 16: monkeys stated no hypoglycemia with dextrose to 30 mg/kg; patients infused in D5NS had drug-related hypoglycemia at 1-6 mg/kg. Toxicity at the effective exposure, margin misplaced >5x: contra; harm counted here, not safety.

entries.note: Boado 2012 DMD resolves; quote verbatim; named hypoglycemia harm from HIR agonism.
Hypoglycemia appeared in patients as predicted in kind; partial is right. If dose 4 becomes contra for the misplaced margin, the count-once rule may remove this from safety (rule question).
Hordeaux 2018 resolves; quote verbatim. REGENXBIO 2022 release reports no drug-related SAEs and no DRG/nerve-conduction readout; untested not_measured holds.

Hinderer 2016 (PMC5240037) full text: quote verbatim but describes the naive (non-tolerized) cohort; tolerized dogs showed 'dose-dependent elevation in CSF IDUA activity similar to the non-tolerized dogs'. Untested opening entry stands; 2016 predates RGX-111 trial.

REGENXBIO 9 Feb 2022 release scraped: quote verbatim; CSF IDUA detectable in 3/4. Tier 5 with trial_unreported and model_src tier 1 correct. Dog model (2016) predates NCT03580083 (2018), so prospective same, not retro.
Hinderer 2016 abstract: MED quote verbatim. No stated exposure target mapped to human per-gram-brain cohorts; untested/unsettled, margin_stated false correct.

Full text: immune-toxicity quote verbatim (non-tolerized dogs). RGX-111 patients received a 48-week immunosuppression regimen per press release, so the prediction was not tested; untested/unsettled correct.
Boado 2008 Biotechnol Bioeng abstract: quote verbatim. Rhesus brain uptake predates NCT03071341; no patient CSF/brain delivery readout reported. Untested/unsettled correct.
Visigalli 2016 Hum Gene Ther abstract: quote verbatim; human HSPC xenografts with clinical-grade LV. Untested opening entry correct, separate system from Idua-/- mouse.
Gentner 2021 NEJM abstract: quote verbatim; supraphysiologic blood IDUA was a primary end point. Xenograft model (2016) predates trial (2018): prospective pairing, same correct.
Visigalli 2016 abstract: GLP tox/biodistribution quote verbatim; supports a stated tolerability prediction. Not the track's latest entry, so no untested_reason needed.
Gentner 2021 abstract: safety (primary end point) similar to autologous HSCT at 2.1 y, quote verbatim. Prospective, same correct; short follow-up for clonal events noted at medium confidence.

No dose entries for the ZFN (SB-318) or AAV9-ICM (RGX-111) tracks; Ou 2018 and Hordeaux 2018 give vector doses translated to the 1e13-5e13 vg/kg and RGX-111 cohorts; not verified whether a stated exposure target exists.
Program status: NCT02702115 TERMINATED and NCT03580083 SUSPENDED per ClinicalTrials.gov; neither changes a status but could be noted.
rule_questions: Phase 1/2 gene-therapy trials here all have safety-only (or safety + transgene-expression) primaries. Should efficacy then be untested (not_measured), or may a registered secondary disease endpoint stand in when no efficacy primary exists at all? I applied the strict rule to efficacy 5-8.

When a model predicted a harm in kind but placed it at a >5x higher dose and patients were not dose-limited by it (valanafusp hypoglycemia), is dose contra without blocked_by, and does count-once then remove the safety same entry?
